entities.name: María Jesús Montero Cuadrado
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María Jesús Montero Cuadrado is a Spanish hospital administrator and politician currently serving as Member of the Congress of Deputies for Seville since 2019. At party level, she serves as Deputy Secretary-General of the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) since 2022 and as Secretary-General of the Andalusia PSOE's branch since 2025.
